mapping.draft_py:
# Refute: "Counter target spell. Draw a card, then discard a card."
# Sentence 1 is the compiler's COUNTER_SPELL (B5a-counter-spell), kept. Sentence 2 is the exact
# sentence's parse in an activated frame (B3-seq-draw-discard, M21 Obsessive Stitcher, verified):
# DRAW 1, then a MOVE_ZONE of one card you choose from your hand to your graveyard.
counter = compiled[0].effect
draw = A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU})
discard = A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
    'cards': Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
        filter=FAnd(children=()),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
    ),
    'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
    'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
})
abilities = [SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.INSTANT, effect=Seq(steps=(counter, draw, discard)))]

clauses.clause: Draw a card, then discard a card.

mapping.notes: The compiler's COUNTER_SPELL is kept; 'Draw a card, then discard a card.' is the exact sentence's parse in an activated frame (B3-seq-draw-discard, M21 Obsessive Stitcher). The probe board has no spell on the stack. Pack: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/refute_counters_then_draws_and_discards.json.

clauses.evidence: Trace: 'cast skipped: a target slot needs 1, the board offers 0' (no spell on the stack). Tree read: COUNTER_SPELL over one TARGET with STACK_KIND_EQ SPELL on the stack. Packs PASS: B02_1 (a creature spell, Highborn Vampire, is countered: it goes to its owner's graveyard and never enters) and B02_2 (two spells on the stack: only the targeted LOWER one, Aegis Turtle, is countered; Giant Growth above it resolves, Bear 5/5). Wrong twins fail.

clauses.clause: Draw a card, then discard a card.
clauses.evidence: Not in the trace. Tree read: DRAW 1 for YOU, then a one-card pick from YOUR hand to YOUR graveyard (the ONE_OF form the compiler gives a count-1 pick). Packs PASS: B02_1 (exactly one card drawn; the discard is chosen from the hand AFTER the draw, the drawn card is offered and discarded, hand ends at 2) and B02_2 (a different card of the caster's choice is discarded, the drawn card stays in hand). The opponent draws and discards nothing. Wrong twins fail.
